run.name: CVR Energy Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (CVI)
run.summary: Standalone credit strength is high: 1.94x gross leverage, 0.55x net and USD 1,853 million of liquidity. The view for creditors is conditional on a pending, debt-funded acquisition and on cycle-high earnings holding. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CVR ENERGY INC.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (reported bridge), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 1,781 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 919; cash 1,278 includes 158 of consolidated VIE cash; excludes pending acquisition debt and 500 minimum cash condition.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 919 over LTM cash interest 132. Coupons are semi-annual, so cash interest is lumpy by quarter, and the window mixes pre- and post-refinancing coupon timing (the new notes' first coupon was due August 15, 2026).

cash.basis: Cash. ABL available 530 (550 less 20 letters of credit) plus CVR Partners ABL 45. Cash includes 158 of consolidated VIE cash; 500 must stay unrestricted until acquisition close; neither facility is drawn.

cashflow.basis: Cash from operations, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Acquisition financing, target earnings and covenant terms are not supplied, so post-closing credit metrics cannot be calculated.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels, the acquisition financing terms and the sustainability of the current earnings level are not supplied.
